name: token-ledger
description: Your 5-hour, weekly, context and cache-hit figures as one line above the prompt, a ? button that asks Haiku 5.5 for questions to ask next, and a /ledger pane with subagent shares. Percentages only, no money.

agentAlertPercent.title: Subagent alert (% of 5-hour limit)
agentAlertPercent.description: Toast once when a single subagent has used about this much of your 5-hour limit. 0 turns it off.

toastOnCacheMiss.title: Toast on cache rewrites
toastOnCacheMiss.description: Show a toast when a turn after an idle gap rewrote the prompt cache.
